contexts.text: Man summons to himself Spirits from Hell according to his life.
The gentiles who are summoned to the Church. Signified.
Good Spirits are adjoined to man by the Lord; but evil ones are summoned by the man himself.
When the evil do this... they summon infernal Societies; and, the more of them they summon the more they infest those who are protected by the Lord.
Certain Spirits were summoned above the head...
Other Spirits were summoned in their place.
